Arcane Death.name: Arcane Death
Arcane Death.description: Caster launches an antimagic sphere at a single target. The target's mana pool is set to 0 and all active magical effects on the target expire, WIL save to negate.

Arcane Shield.name: Arcane Shield
Arcane Shield.description: Several shields appear, protecting willing targets from attacks. This spell grants the targets' 4 + 1/2F to their shield DVs in addition to providing them a temporary barrier that absorbs 35 + 5/F damage. The arcane shield is active until the end of the caster's next turn.

Backlash.name: Backlash
Backlash.description: For this spell's duration, when the caster is targeted by or starts a turn under the effect of a spell cast by another creature, the caster of that spell suffers 2 + 1/2F d20 adaptive damage. Backlash does not distinguish between enemies and allies.

Counterspell.name: Counterspell
Counterspell.description: This spell is used as a reaction to an attempt to cast another spell. If the targeted spellcaster loses a contested WIL check against the caster, the spell does not go off.

Delay.name: Delay
Delay.description: This spell is used as a reaction to an attempt to cast another spell. If the target loses in a contested WIL check against the caster, the spell fizzles and is nullified. The spell will return to reality at the end of the caster's next 1 + 1/2F turns, going to the same location - offending spells will treat any target at the location as the new target.

Dispel.name: Dispel
Dispel.description: 1 + 1/2F target spell effects end, WIL save by the effect's caster to negate. Targets must always attempt to resist this spell. Permanent effects are only suppressed for up to one hour on a failed save.

Forcelock.name: Forcelock
Forcelock.description: A barrier forms at the target location. It forms into either a wall with dimensions of 30' tall, 30' long and 2'' thick, or into a 15' radius hollow sphere. If the barrier were to annihilate a target by cutting them in half, they are instead pushed onto a side determined by the caster, unless they cannot fit, then they are forced outwards. Anything moving through the barrier on either side loses all momentum and any remaining actions, regaining them at the start of their next turn. They can continue forward in either direction on their next turn. Spells whose collisions interact with the barrier do not affect it, instead, they wrap around it and disperse harmlessly on its surface.

Halt Magic.name: Halt Magic
Halt Magic.description: Caster blocks the target's ability to transmit magic, forcing them to spend an additional 3 + 1/F mana to cast a spell, WIL save to negate.

Mage Armor.name: Mage Armor
Mage Armor.description: An arcane aura of the caster's choice surrounds them, granting the caster 8 + 1/2F armor DVs.

Redirect.name: Redirect
Redirect.description: This spell is used as a reaction to an attempt to cast another spell. Caster may choose to redirect the spell at a target within 60' + 20'/F - becoming the new caster of the spell, PWR save to negate, though retaining the original spell's resistance check. The caster also gains an inherent knowledge of the spell upon redirecting it. Caster may choose to allow the spell to glow with an aura denoting the caster's element.

Resist Magic.name: Resist Magic
Resist Magic.description: A mark of the caster's choice appears above a willing target for the spell's duration. When a resistance check or save targets them, they gain 2 + 1/4F placed rolls on up to 2 + 1/2F checks or saves before the mark and spell expire. All checks count as a use, even if they are not resisted.

Shield.name: Shield
Shield.description: A mark of the caster's choice appears above a willing target. The mark generates a magical barrier that absorbs (Rank) damage before breaking, all remaining damage continuing as normal. This shield reapplies itself to the target at the start of each round.

Silent Field.name: Silent Field
Silent Field.description: A shimmering field of anti-magic energy grows over the indicated area. Any targets in the area of the spell's effect are spell jammed. Silent Field negates any continuous or focus spells in the area. Magic (buffs, debuffs, charms, and items) does not function in the area - though magic begins working again once outside the radius. Magic targeting characters in the area disperse harmlessly, fizzling without effect.

Silent Ward.name: Silent Ward
Silent Ward.description: A mark of the caster's choice appears above willing targets for the spell's duration. Each target receives a temporary barrier that absorbs 12 + 2/F damage. This shield reapplies itself to the targets at the start of each round.

Sorcerous Shield.name: Sorcerous Shield
Sorcerous Shield.description: Caster creates a swirling wall of collected magical energy in front of themselves that negates incoming magical energy, causing area of effect spells to wrap around the shield and projectiles to dissipate on its side. The barrier itself has a HP total of 110 +20/F and breaks upon receiving that much damage from spells. When a target walks through the shield, all magical effects affecting them are targeted by Dispel - Interdictions 2. As a Swift Action, the caster may move the barrier 10' in any direction.

Steal Energy.name: Steal Energy
Steal Energy.description: Caster steals the target's magical energy. They receive the caster's choice of an inferior WIL, CHA, or INT while a separate target of the caster's choice gains an exceptional of the same attribute, WIL save to negate.
